product.title: Tower of London: Guided Tour with Thames River Cruise

description.text: Combine a guide-led visit to the Tower of London with a sighseeing cruise along the River Thames on this two-in-one tour. Meet your guide at Parliament Square before hopping on a riverboat along the Thames for a new view on the London skyline. Stops include Parliament Square, Thames River, Tower of London, Crown Jewels. Then, hop off at the Tower of London, where you’ll explore the famous monument, which dates to 1066, and houses the Crown Jewels. Ideal for visitors basing in London who want a guided city experience without coordinating Tube routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
